description: This file defines a React component called MotionProvider that provides animated page transitions and utility animation components using framer-motion. It includes animation variants, context setup, and several reusable animated UI components like FadeIn, SlideIn, StaggeredList, ScaleIn, HoverScale, PulseLoader, and AnimatedCheckmark.

methods.name: MotionProvider
methods.description: A React component that provides animated page transitions based on pathname using framer-motion. Also includes utility components for animations such as FadeIn, SlideIn, etc.

methods.name: FadeIn
methods.description: A React component that applies a fade-in animation with optional delay and duration.

methods.name: SlideIn
methods.description: A React component for sliding in children elements from a specified direction with animation.

methods.name: StaggeredList
methods.description: A React component that applies staggered animations to its children elements.

methods.name: StaggeredItem
methods.description: A React component representing a single item in a staggered animation list.

methods.name: ScaleIn
methods.description: A React component that scales in its children with animation.

methods.name: HoverScale
methods.description: A React component that adds a scale effect on hover and tap for its children.

methods.name: PulseLoader
methods.description: A small animated pulsing loader component.

methods.name: AnimatedCheckmark
methods.description: An animated checkmark component that appears with scale and rotation animation when visible.
